key_insight: LambdaMix learns a family of preference-conditioned language model policies in one training run, enabling inference-time trade-offs without further optimization.
engineering_relevance: Teams can adapt deployed model behavior to changing priorities using jointly trained low-rank adapters rather than maintaining separate specialist policies.
method: Freeze the base model and jointly train one low-rank adapter per objective with group-relative online reinforcement learning.
Use one preference vector to select the adapter mixture and weight separately normalized objective rewards.
Change the preference vector at inference to steer objective trade-offs.
evidence_signal: Across four models on helpfulness–harmlessness and math–instruction-following tasks, LambdaMix achieved higher hypervolume than all evaluated conditioned and policy-merging baselines while using fewer training completions and stored adapter parameters than GRPO specialists.
watch_item: Results cover a limited set of objectives and models; performance with more objectives or under deployment distribution shifts remains unestablished.
paper_title: Steerable Multi-Objective Group-Relative Preference Optimization with Jointly Trained Low-Rank Adapters
